source.provenance: AI-generated still keypose sheet supplied for CYBR step-in-cross authoring

estimator.name: MediaPipe Pose GHUM
estimator.note: 2D landmark positions are source-image pixels. Hidden-side landmarks are model guesses, even when visibility is high; no depth or timing is inferred.

pose_order_basis: left-to-right then top-to-bottom panel order; duration and spacing unspecified

qa.laterality_note: Generated panels are independent stills. Detector LEFT/RIGHT labels and occluded joints require human review before rig-side mapping.
limitations: Generated images are not observations of physical continuity or contact forces.
Far-side arms and legs can be occluded or anatomically mislabeled.
Two-dimensional joint positions alone cannot determine 3D rotations or root trajectory.
